description: This file contains implementation of a serializer class 'SkipFieldCodec' that skips all fields it encounters during serialization/deserialization, along with extension methods for the 'Reader' class to facilitate skipping various wire types in the Orleans serialization protocol.

classes.name: SkipFieldCodec
classes.description: A serializer class that skips all fields it encounters during serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: SkipFieldExtension
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for the 'Reader' class to skip fields based on wire type.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Method intended to write a field, but currently not implemented.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value from the reader, skipping the field and returning null.

methods.name: SkipField
methods.description: Extension method to skip a field based on its wire type.

methods.name: ThrowUnexpectedExtendedWireType
methods.description: Throws an exception for an unexpected extended wire type.

methods.name: ThrowUnexpectedWireType
methods.description: Throws an exception for an unexpected wire type.

methods.name: SkipLengthPrefixedField
methods.description: Skips a length-prefixed field by reading its length and skipping that many bytes.

methods.name: SkipTagDelimitedField
methods.description: Skips a tag-delimited field by reading headers until the end of the object.
